record.question: Telangana became the
record.explanation: Answer C: 29th State of India. Telangana became India's 29 th state on 2 June 2014, through the division of Andhra Pradesh into two states. This added one state to the then total of 28; the question asks its historical formation order. Historical/source note: Historical state-formation ordinal, not the current total number of Indian states. Reference: https://sansad.in/uploads/JPI_september2014_E_3ca32160c8.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
